AUTHOR: Maeda
TITLE: A Novel Application of Deep Learning-Based Estimation of Fish Abundance and Temporal Patterns in Agricultural Drainage Canals for Sustainable Ecosystem Monitoring
REGION: Agricultural drainage canal, Miho Village, Ibaraki Prefecture, Japan
DATA: Own time-lapse camera images (Brinno TLC200Pro) from 4 survey days 2024-2025; 675 annotated images for train/val; 12,600-image inference set (22 July 2024)
V_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'the underwater images were generally turbid and only captured clear outlines when the fish were close to the camera'; Sec. 2.2: water depth 0.44 m
D2: Train/val 546/129 images (~4:1) mainly from 3 other days + 2% of inference-day images; test = 300 random images from the 12,600-image inference day
D_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'we intentionally included an additional 2.0% of the images from the inference dataset... This inclusion created a small overlap between the training and inference datasets (approximately 2%)'
R_EV: Sec. 3.2/Table 4 vs Table 3: on the July inference day 'the overall Precision decreased by 6.2% to 88.9% ... Recall declined substantially by 41.3% to 47.1%'
C_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'the F1 score for both target species peaked at a confidence threshold of 0.427'; Sec. 2.6: count corrected for 'multiple detections of the same individual across consecutive frames'
E_EV: Sec. 3.3: 'it was estimated that approximately 7300 individual P. parva passed through the field of view between 6:00:00 and 12:59:58'
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP50, mAP50-95, confusion matrix
NOTE: Train/val days (Apr, Sep, Mar) differ from inference/test day (Jul) at same site -> coded as day-level split and season-level external test, but ~2% of test-day images were added to training (acknowledged overlap, D4=Y); test images are 300 random frames from that day. Thresholds: 0.427 F1-max, sensitivity analysis on conf and NMS IoU; 0.7 for carp in counting. Duplicate counting handled by dividing by empirically set detections-per-individual (Rframes 2.5/5) -> coded C5 duplicate handling; this is a crude mechanism, verifier may judge C5 = 없음 (then C_ALL = P). Counts are corrected using recall (FN rate) -> E4 = FNR. No comparison of counts with manual census (E2 = N). Daytime-only acquisition 'to ensure sufficient visibility' (illumination, not turbidity exclusion) -> P1 not applied. Within-day temporal occurrence series also reported (Fig. 9).
